name: Globus Spirits Limited
summary: Globus Spirits Limited manufactures and sells bulk alcohol and alcoholic products in India and internationally. It operates through two segments: Manufacturing and Consumer. The company offers Indian-made Indian liquor and Indian-made foreign liquor products; and produces and sells ethanol, extra neutral alcohol, rectified spirit, and premium spirits. It also provides distillery products, including grain-neutral alcohol, bioethanol, special denatured spirit, technical alcohol, and fusel oil, as well as other industrial spirits and by-products, etc.; and alcoholic beverages, including prestige and value spirits.
